en: Black-and-white postcard view of a railway station building with arched windows and a central two‑story section. People walk across a cobblestone square in front of the station, where bicycles and a few mid‑20th‑century cars are parked. Old‑style streetlamps and some trees frame the scene. Printed caption text appears at the lower left, and a publisher's imprint with copyright information is at the lower right.
